slides.title: NGN NCLEX-RN Question
text: The nurse in the emergency department is caring for a 52-year-old client with cirrhosis, abdominal distention and a history of opioid and alcohol abuse. Disoriented to time. Intermittent, slow response to questions during interview. Abdominal striae observed. Asterixis to hands. The client cannot recall the time of last void. T 99.2° F (37.3° C), P 96, RR 18 deep and slow, BP 138/88. Serum potassium level is 3.6 mEq/L. Serum ammonia level is 82 mcg/dL.
For each nursing intervention, specify whether the intervention needs to be incorporated or not incorporated in the client’s care plan.
(Place an X in the intervention box to the right)
Limit client’s sodium intake to 1 g daily.
Remind client to apply favorite skin moisturizer.
